correctness.rationale: All 65536 subsets per graph and every Hasse incidence are exhausted; acyclic matchings have respectively critical cells 1/1/106 and 1/1/58 in degrees 0/2/3. Signed integral Morse differential has an actual +1 unit coefficient in each graph; mapping-cone cancellation and nullhomotopic remaining attachments prove wedges of 105 and 57 three-spheres. Independent complete mod-two ranks agree. Boundaries, all quantifiers, code, and normalization checked on actual standalone files.

value.rationale: A complete motivated cutoff-two integral homotopy classification for the canonical nonisomorphic strongly regular pair, identical (16,6,2,2), identical minimal forbidden triple number 176, and identical low-skeleton counts, nonetheless produces 105 versus 57 three-spheres. Exact homotopy is stronger than scalar enumerative distinctions; the fact can be used as a stringent higher-independence benchmark without claiming a general theorem.
